dogecoin.text:
I've run a Dogecoin full node, but not a Bitcoin full node.

Can't believe I fucked up this much. It's not so much about the money, but more that I'm disappointed in myself.🤦‍♂️

Meh, 20-30 million sats is enough to build a vacuum balloon... only thing I really need to get done.

Installed SSD from broken laptop on new laptop and it boots to Windows with the Fedora partition appearing to be missing. Windows has all the files I left there, including the Dogecoin blockchain, and it appears to be the full size of SSD. Is this fixable or are other files gone?

It's kind of nuts that dogecoin is still way above $0.01, and I think this might be extremely bullish for bitcoin.

Only way for it to be as high as it is is if doge OGs lost keys, which seems to suggest there might be a lot more lost bitcoin than people expect.
